headline.purpose: Per-tab screen title (ScreenTitle) — one per screen, top of content.

title.purpose: Profile name in the header; card-level titles.

body.purpose: Buttons and general UI text; inputs use this role at 16px to avoid iOS zoom.

label.purpose: Section labels, field labels, tab bar captions.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Default resting elevation for cards — soft top highlight plus diffuse drop shadow, no border.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Bottom sheets and modals — a deeper version of the card recipe.

shadows.name: button-primary
shadows.purpose: Coral glow under the primary gradient button.

motion.name: spring-default
motion.purpose: App-wide default transition — critically damped, no overshoot.

motion.name: spring-momentum
motion.purpose: Reserved for momentum-driven / celebratory moments only.

motion.name: spring-snappy
motion.purpose: Tap feedback (whileTap scale-down) on buttons and chips.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action — pill shape, warm gradient fill, coral glow shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14.5px; letter-spacing: -0.1px; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b4a 0%, #ff2d55 100%); border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 11px 20px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -4px rgba(255,45,85,0.5); transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action next to a Primary button — glass fill, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14.5px; letter-spacing: -0.1px; color: #98989f; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Toggle chip — inverts to solid light fill when active, the one light-on-dark inversion in the system.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: -0.1px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 14px; cursor: pointer; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #98989f; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-chip-active { background: #f5f5f7; color: #0a0a0d; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Base container — translucent glass fill, soft shadow, no border.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); padding: 16px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input — glass fill, no border at rest, coral glow ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #f5f5f7; padding: 11px 14px; border-radius: 16px; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.1px; border: none; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0px transparent; transition: box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,59,92,0.14); }

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar Item
components.description: One tab in the fixed bottom navigation — icon + label, active state gets a gradient indicator bar.
components.css: .ds-tab { position: relative; flex: 1; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 10px 0 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: #57575f; } .ds-tab-active { color: #f5f5f7; } .ds-tab-indicator { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 20%; right: 20%; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b4a 0%, #ff2d55 100%); } .ds-tab-label { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.1px; }

components.name: Floating Action Button
components.description: The primary create-new action for a list-home screen, anchored bottom-right above the tab bar (thumb zone), instead of the header.
components.html: <button class="ds-fab"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Añadir</button>
components.css: .ds-fab { position: fixed; bottom: calc(70px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); right: max(20px, calc((100vw - 480px) / 2 + 20px)); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b4a 0%, #ff2d55 100%); border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 14px 20px 14px 16px; color: #fff; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -6px rgba(255,45,85,0.55); cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Confirm-Delete Control (armed state)
components.description: The armed state of every destructive delete in the app: a tap on the trigger swaps it for this Cancel/Confirm pair, both with a 44px minimum hit box, auto-disarming after 4s.
components.css: .ds-confirm-delete { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; } .ds-confirm-cancel, .ds-confirm-confirm { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: none; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-confirm-cancel { background: none; color: #98989f; } .ds-confirm-confirm { background: #ff3b5c; color: #fff; }

narrative.overview:
Gym-App reads like a focused instrument, not a lifestyle app: a near-black canvas that gets out of the way, translucent glass panels that layer content without cluttering it, and a single warm accent that appears only where it means something (a primary action, an active tab, a highlighted metric). Nothing is decorative. Every surface exists to get a number logged and get out of the user's way, on a phone, one-handed, mid-workout.

The one indulgence is motion: cards and sheets settle into place with critically-damped spring physics rather than linear fades, so the app feels alive without feeling loud. There is no hero imagery, no marketing flourish — the personality lives entirely in restraint, materials (glass, blur, soft shadow), and the rare warm gradient.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas (#08080c) with translucent "glass" surfaces layered on top, never flat white cards on black.
One accent — a warm coral-to-red gradient — reserved for primary actions and active states.
Cards float via soft diffuse shadow, never a hard border.
Full pill radius on every button and chip; larger surfaces (cards, sheets) step down to 24px/32px corners instead.
Motion is spring-based and critically damped (no bounce) everywhere except momentum/celebratory moments.
A single typeface (Inter) carries the whole hierarchy through size and weight alone — no secondary display font.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The ember gradient/coral is the only warm color in the system. It marks exactly one thing per screen — the primary action or the active state — never a decorative fill.

rules.name: The No Hard Edge Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from shadow and blur, never from a 1px border on a card. Borders/hairlines are reserved for dividers and the dashed "add" affordance.

rules.name: The Two-Tap Delete Rule
rules.body: Nothing in this app is ever deleted from a single tap. Every destructive action arms on the first tap (ui/ConfirmDeleteButton.tsx) and requires a second, deliberate tap on a distinct control to confirm.

dos: Do reserve the ember gradient/coral for exactly one thing per screen — a primary action or the active state (The One Voice Rule).
Do convey card edges with the Card shadow (soft inset highlight + diffuse drop shadow); never add a border to a card.
Do use the critically-damped spring (bounce: 0, duration: 0.35) as the motion default; reserve the slight-bounce spring (0.25) for momentum/celebratory moments only.
Do keep any text-input font-size at 16px minimum to prevent iOS Safari's zoom-on-focus.
Do give every button/chip full pill radius regardless of size; step containers down through the fixed sm/md/lg/xl scale instead.
donts: Don't add a hard 1px border to a card for definition — hairline/hairline-strong are for dividers and the dashed "add" tile only.
Don't use bounce/elastic easing for standard taps or transitions; it's reserved for the rare momentum moment.
Don't introduce a second accent hue — protein intentionally reuses the primary accent color rather than getting its own.
Don't nest a second scroll container inside the content region; the header and tab bar are fixed/sticky specifically so there is exactly one scrollable area.
